summary.description: One or two plain sentences: what was done and what the final state is.

question.description: Empty unless status is needs_confirmation. Then: the exact yes/no question, naming what will happen and to whom.

observed_before.description: What the app showed before the first action (from accessibility text or screenshot).

observed_after.description: What the app shows now, as observed by a fresh get_app_state after the last action.

evidence.description: Absolute screenshot paths (no file:// prefix) or data URLs that support the summary.

actions_taken.description: One line per UI action, in order.

reason.description: Empty unless status is blocked or failed. Then: the exact error or obstacle, quoted.
